top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a single, settled invention: magic-wavelength trapping of many atoms in an optical lattice, realized at about 1e-18 and reproduced and surpassed in several laboratories. The allocation to Katori and Ye is uncontested across the committee, and a narrow citation tied to the invention and the accuracy reached keeps it separable from the 2005 and 2012 prizes. P002 (magic-angle graphene) is scientifically strong but younger, with the pairing mechanism unresolved and a three-way credit; it is clearly preferable to no award.
